purpose: choose the frozen V2.1b shot condition for class-resolved ISI instrumentation and as the future temporal-irregularity background
rule: among V2.1b cells with E rate in [2, 30] Hz in all three analysis windows, choose the maximum over cells of the minimum pooled ISI-CV fraction (frac_in) across windows
declared: 2026-09-16, after V2.1b pooled outcomes were known and before any class-resolved ISI outcome; the rule uses only sealed pooled fields
authority: reviewer disposition after V2.1b (in-band condition with the strongest ISI improvement)
reading_rule: E_IRREGULAR iff E frac_in >= 0.8 in every window; UNRESOLVED if the rerun does not reproduce the sealed cell exactly
